note: No Ego-Exo4D annotation file is downloadable without the signed license (the GitHub tutorial notebooks ship without outputs), so both examples are the documentation's own sample snippets, copied verbatim with their // comments and '...' elisions (hence raw_format txt, not valid JSON). Example 1 is one expert-commentary entry (the expert paused at video_time and spoke; Whisper transcript); example 2 is the first two keystep segments of a take plus the start of the keystep taxonomy and vocabulary. No clip: videos need the license.
